reviews.title: Not well done
reviews.body: Brief content visible, double tap to read full content.Full content visible, double tap to read brief content.I worked on this for a month and some of the names I just could not eliminate. It is 12 point font and I had to separate almost every page from the binding to actually be able to see the inside names, both that others have mentioned. I didn’t mind the repetitiveness of the tasks but when you have names you can’t eliminate with the clues and your goal is to get down to one name… each page I kept ending up with 20+ names I couldn’t eliminate. Frustrating and a waste of time if you can never actually eliminate an entire page using the clues 🙄. Skip this one.Read moreRead less

reviews.title: Must have for puzzle lovers
reviews.body: Brief content visible, double tap to read full content.Full content visible, double tap to read brief content.Talk about an immersive long term puzzle "project". I opened this book and began with the first clue thinking how easy it was going to be. An hour later, and several missed text messages from my completely ignored phone, I was completely engrossed in this book. This is not a quick solve. I've already changed my approach to add highlighters, sticky notes, the always helpful magnifying glass for when my eyes get tired, and a timer to remind me to take breaks and let my brain relax. What an amazing adventure this is going to be.Read moreRead less

reviews.title: Puzzle not a novel
reviews.body: Brief content visible, double tap to read full content.Full content visible, double tap to read brief content.Not sure where the five star ratings talking about the engaging plot are coming from. This is a puzzle book and not a very good one. reviews.title: Bo-Ringggg
reviews.body: Brief content visible, double tap to read full content.Full content visible, double tap to read brief content.I've done other books like this that were fun. This was not. It started out fine, with clues that eliminated entire pages. And some of the other clues were ok. But when you're perusing over 100 pages of tiny font first eliminating every name with a double letter, which would take weeks, then ever name whose first and last name share the same vowel, which would take weeks, etc. It can be very monotonous. Threw it out after 50+ hours of working on the thing. Other books like this are more creative and fun. This book feels like AI.Read moreRead less
